configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server to be displayed on the server list

configurationFields.label: Message Of The Day
configurationFields.description: Sets the message of the day (MOTD) displayed when players join

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for in-game admin commands. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server

configurationFields.label: Save Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the world directory to load, or to create if it does not already exist

configurationFields.label: Speicherintervall
configurationFields.description: Sets the save interval for the server. 1 in-game hour = 5 minutes in real time

configurationFields.label: Disable Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: If set, anti-cheat will be disabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Game Difficulty
configurationFields.description: Sets the game difficulty level. If Custom is selected, server parameters can be set under Custom Difficulty Settings

configurationFields.label: Disable Wave
configurationFields.description: If set, there will be no wave

configurationFields.label: Activate Building Forbidden Area
configurationFields.description: If set, the building forbidden area will be activated

configurationFields.label: Disable Zombie Respawn
configurationFields.description: If set, zombies will not respawn

configurationFields.label: Enable Natural Objects Respawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, natural objects will respawn

configurationFields.label: Enable Synthetic Objects Respawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, synthetic objects will respawn

configurationFields.label: Disable Generator Breakdown
configurationFields.description: If set, generators will not break down

configurationFields.label: Disable Research Loss On Death
configurationFields.description: If set, research will not be lost on death

configurationFields.label: Enable Item Drop On Exit
configurationFields.description: If enabled, items will be dropped on exit

configurationFields.label: Disable Team Kill
configurationFields.description: If set, team kill will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Building Decay
configurationFields.description: If set, building decay will occur after 5 days of inactivity

configurationFields.label: Wave Zombie Amount Limit
